mechanism_narrative: The current level of the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is inversely related to S&P 500 forward returns: lower rates compress discount rates and boost equity valuations, producing positive 20-day returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline when FEDFUNDS is below 2.5% (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A CPIAUCSL reading above 255.0 indicates elevated inflation, prompting central bank tightening and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline when CPIAUCSL > 255.0 (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 2.5%) and high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 255.0) create a stagflationary environment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline when FEDFUNDS < 2.5 and CPIAUCSL > 255.0 (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a low unemployment regime (UNRATE < 3.5%), the labor market is tight, supporting corporate earnings growth and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline when UNRATE < 3.5 (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A HOUST reading below 1200 indicates a weakening housing market, signaling economic slowdown and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline when HOUST < 1200 (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: The current level of industrial production (INDPRO) is positively related to S&P 500 forward returns: higher industrial output indicates robust economic activity, supporting positive 60-day returns.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline when INDPRO is above 100 (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When labor market strength (PAYEMS) declines and consumer spending (RSAFS) falls, the S&P 500 forward returns are negative over the next 20 trading days due to recessionary fears.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline when PAYEMS declines and RSAFS declines (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a strong economic growth regime (GDPC1 growth rate > 1.5% year-over-year), the S&P 500 forward returns are positive over the next 60 trading days due to robust corporate earnings.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline when GDPC1 growth rate > 1.5% (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
